# RapidJSON (vendored)

Header-only JSON parser used by `libohos_render/utils/json` (SAX reader).

- Upstream: https://github.com/Tencent/rapidjson
- Pinned commit: 24b5e7a8b27f42fa16b96fc70aade9106cf7102f
- Only `include/rapidjson/**` headers are vendored (no tests/examples/docs).
- License: see `license.txt` (MIT).

To update: replace `include/rapidjson/` from the desired upstream commit and
update the commit hash above.
